## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 给没有字段分组的对象新建完整记录页(或把默认页「转为完整页面」)时,「More details / 更多详情」分区的标题不再写成英文原文,而是写成每种内置语言各一条的多语言写法(取自语言包 `detail.sectionMoreDetails`),保存后的页面按查看者的语言显示。对象自己语言包里的 `_sections.details.label` 仍然优先。
- 为什么改:运行中的记录页会翻译这个标题,但 Studio 生成的页面把它存成英文字符串,非英文用户打开保存过的页面看到的是 "More details"。#33470 已为「其他」分区用了同一写法。
- 风险与回滚:只改 Studio 生成页面的方式,不改 spec、不改运行中的记录页、不迁移已保存的页面(它们仍显示英文,对象语言包的覆盖照样生效)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.ts` 的 `loadPersistedSectionLabels`;`metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.tsx` 的 `convertToFull`;`metadata-admin/anchors.ts` 的 record 页 `createSeed`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.studioMoreDetailsHeading-33471.test.tsx`,预期 5 条全绿(中文显示「更多详情」,英文显示 "More details",对象语言包的标题优先)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Measured first, on `origin/main` (`8e63ed87`).** Studio's create seed (`metadata-admin/anchors.ts`, record page `kind: 'full'`) and `PagePreview.tsx` `convertToFull` passed `MORE_DETAILS_DEFAULT_LABEL` as the `details` section's label, so the saved section was `{ name: 'details', label: 'More details', … }`. The red-first run below draws that saved seed through the real `RecordDetailsRenderer` under `zh-CN`: 「更多详情」 is not on the page (the English text is), while en and an object bundle carrying `_sections.details.label` read correctly. It reproduces.

**How `record:details` resolves the heading (the measurement the order asked for).** In `plugin-detail` `record-details.tsx`, a section's `label` is first resolved for the viewer with `pickLocalized(s.label, language)`, and when the section has a `name`, that text is passed as the FALLBACK to `sectionLabel(objectName, s.name, rawTitle ?? s.name)`, which answers `objects.OBJECT._sections.NAME.label` when the bundle has it (`useObjectLabel` `sectionLabel` → `resolve(objectSuffixes(…), fallback)`). So an inline locale map never shadows the per-object override: the override wins over the map exactly as it wins over a string. Leaving `label` unset would not help either: the fallback then becomes the literal section name `details`. ⇒ the form #33470 chose for the ungrouped bucket fits here too, and this PR uses it. The CONTROL pin below draws the override winning over the map.

**The change.**

- `recordDetailSections.ts`: `loadPersistedUngroupedHeading` becomes `loadPersistedSectionLabels(objectDef)`, which answers both headings the derivation writes itself, each as the inline locale map of its catalogue key over every catalogue `@object-ui/i18n` ships (`BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES` + `loadBuiltInLocale`): `moreDetails` from `detail.sectionMoreDetails`, `ungrouped` from `common.ungroupedSection` (unchanged). It loads the catalogues only when the page writes one of them (the object's `fieldGroups` apply, or the flat split yields a `details` section), and otherwise answers the English defaults, which no section reads. One catalogue that fails to load rejects the whole call (`Promise.all`), so no partial map is ever saved (the #33470 rule). `RecordDetailSectionLabels.moreDetails` widens from `string` to `SectionHeading` (app-shell internal).
- `anchors.ts` (create seed) and `PagePreview.tsx` (`convertToFull`) pass `loadPersistedSectionLabels`' answer. "Convert to full page" stays disabled until it has loaded for the current object, as before, and stays unavailable if a catalogue fails.
- The running record page (`RecordDetailView`) and the slotted preview still pass the translated text; they are untouched.

**What an existing page shows.** No migration. A page saved before this change keeps `label: 'More details'` (a plain string): every viewer reads English, unless the object's bundle carries `_sections.details.label`, which still wins. An author can change the heading in the page designer, or re-create the page.

## Why

The running record page translates the "More details" heading for every viewer; a page Studio seeded saved it as English, so the same page read differently once saved. #33470 settled the persisted form for the sibling "Other" heading; this applies it to the other heading the seed writes itself.

## Tests

- **New: `recordDetailSections.studioMoreDetailsHeading-33471.test.tsx`** (5 tests, the real `RecordDetailsRenderer` under `I18nProvider`, as #33470's pins).
  - The seed for a flat object with a long-text field writes `details.label` as the map of every shipped catalogue's `detail.sectionMoreDetails` (keys = `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES`, `en` "More details", `zh-Hans` 「更多详情」), never a string; firing control: the split yields `[['name','subject'],['notes']]`.
  - The seeded sections parse under the spec's `RecordDetailsProps`.
  - Drawn under `zh-CN`: 「更多详情」, no "More details", above the `notes` value.
  - CONTROL, `en`: "More details".
  - CONTROL: an object bundle with `_sections.details.label` (「补充信息」) wins over the saved map.
- **New leg in `PagePreview.slottedDefault-27054.test.tsx`**: "Convert to full page" on a flat object with a textarea writes the `details` section under the same map, and the converted page passes `validateMetadataDraft('page', …)` and the block props check.
- **Adjusted sibling pins** (they asserted the English string this card removes):
  - `recordDetailSections.studioUngroupedHeading-33377.test.tsx` CONTROL: a flat object's primary section stays unheaded and only its `details` section carries a map; a page that writes neither heading answers the English defaults (it called the removed `loadPersistedUngroupedHeading`).
  - `recordDetailSections.agreement-12442.test.ts`: the flat seed equals the runtime split with the persisted headings, and `details.label.en` is "More details".
